messages.subject: Package and GGOBI trouble
parts:
This is more of a Unix question, but I'm posting it here for more newcomer-friendly advice. I getting the following error message when trying to install the rggobi package under R Studio under Max OSX 10.6. How do I get GGOBI in the right path -- I'm out of my depth here.

With thanks
Mark Ravina
Professor of HIstory
Emory University
Atlanta GA 30030
404.727.4025

messages.subject: Re: Package and GGOBI trouble
parts:
On 16.12.2011 23:21 (UTC+1), Ravina, Mark wrote:
> This is more of a Unix question, but I'm posting it here for more newcomer-friendly advice. I getting the following error message when trying to install the rggobi package under R Studio under Max OSX 10.6. How do I get GGOBI in the right path -- I'm out of my depth here.

are you sure that ggobi is installed? There is no hint in your
description about a ggobi installation itself. rggobi is only a kind of
"wrapper" for it. Also it seems there is no Gtk2 installed?

Please have a look at http://www.ggobi.org/downloads/ . I personally
have no OSX so I am not able to test this.

Hope this helps,
Rainer
